prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: standalone high resolution illustrative construction photograph for Tomoroga Construct website.
Primary request: Regenerate the photographic scene from the supplied reference as one clean edge-to-edge photograph, approximately 1800 by 1140 pixels, landscape ratio 1.58:1. Match the reference composition closely: a very large modern industrial steel hall with open bays, seen from a low diagonal exterior angle. Building stretches from distant left toward close upper right. Corrugated charcoal grey steel upper walls, fair-faced concrete lower walls, multiple open bays revealing black roof trusses, ceiling strip lights and restrained authentic industrial equipment. Large nearest bay is at right. Warm sunset low at far left with natural gold cloud edges in a pale blue sky. Broad smooth slightly reflective concrete apron fills the lower quarter.
Input image: industrial crop is a composition and photographic lighting reference only. Recreate obscured foreground naturally; remove the solid grey overlay completely.
Style/medium: convincing professional architectural photography, detailed real materials, physically plausible construction, natural warm colours, controlled contrast.
Constraints: exactly one standalone photograph; no page layout, UI, captions, written words, letters, watermarks, logos, numbers, annotations, hotspot circles or graphic overlays. This is an illustrative concept photograph, not a representation of an actual completed company project.
